name: ai-news-aggregator-root
description: Root workspace runner for the AI News Aggregator application

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,frontend "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npx rimraf .next && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd frontend && npm run build
